instruction: Cinematic film still, medium close-up. In a classical hall with a balcony visible in the background, the man in the brown shirt and beanie (R1) on the left and the woman in the black dress (R2) on the right stand extremely close. The man (R1) is seen from a three-quarter back view, his face in profile as he leans in. The woman (R2), with a white scarf tied in her hair, has her eyes closed as their foreheads and noses nearly touch. Soft, warm light enhances the tender, quiet mood.

R2 keeps her eyes closed as R1 leans close to her
